description: This shell script contains test cases for the `git clone` command, particularly focusing on the behavior of the `--branch` (`-b`) option. It sets up repositories, performs clone operations, and verifies various clone behaviors, including branch selection and remote tracking.

methods.name: check_HEAD
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD of the cloned repository matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks that the specified file content matches the expected content.
